newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds track U.S. in light trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds track U.S. in light trade.

text.p: *Australian bond yields closed lower on the day, but this was purely a function of a firm U.S. market with little locally to stir activity from the pre-holiday mode.
The Australian government bond market spent another session mainly marking time ahead of the year-end holidays, although yields were sharply lower reflecting renewed strength in U.S. Treasuries.

Traders said the market lacked any conviction other than some profit-taking from domestic institutions after overseas buying had ramped the market higher in afterhours trading on the back of the U.S. market.
Turnover is expected to remain light next week, although today's release of the Federal Open Market Committee minutes for November is expected to set the trend next week.

The yield curve flattened as the local long end benefitted from the strength of the U.S. market following a barrage of market friendly U.S. data and a good response to a U.S. five-year note auction. Canadian bonds outperformed the bloc, rebounding from Wednesday's CPI-led sell-off,
